en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a steam cargo ship moored at an industrial port. The vessel has a large central funnel emitting dark smoke, with two stars painted on a light band around the funnel. Several cranes stand along the quay behind the ship, and long warehouse buildings line the dock. The water in the foreground is calm and there are no people clearly visible.
